1. Case 1: T-cell lymphoma with vasculitis
Skin biopsy showing a monomorphic perivascular/adnexal atypical T-cell infiltrate with aberrant CD4/CD8 coexpression and abnormal flow cytometry, together with splenomegaly and lymphadenopathy, strongly supports T-cell lymphoma with secondary vasculitic ulceration. No further subtyping is possible from current evidence.
